detailed_description:
The target video is in a live-action cinematic realism style with natural dusk window light, photographic skin texture and hair detail, and a restrained, tense dramatic tone. No subtitles, no background music, no narration; all sound is diegetic.
[Shot 1] A medium shot opens on <Subject 3>, the dusk hospital ward from <Picture 3>: the hospital bed with white pillow and gray blanket, the wooden bedside table with its warm glowing lamp, the vase of daisies, the framed photo, and the monitors glowing with green waveforms in the background, all bathed in soft window light. <Subject 1> Lin Dashan, the elderly man with silver-gray combed-back hair, thin metal-rimmed glasses, and a gaunt wrinkled face in his dark gray tunic, lies in the bed with his eyes fully open. His cold gaze sweeps slowly toward frame-left — the off-screen position of 林初, who is never shown — then locks onto <Subject 2> Zhou Fen, the middle-aged woman with voluminous curly brown hair and red floral sweatshirt, who kneels on the floor beside the bed, her face full of terror, her body trembling visibly. The camera performs a slow, steady push-in toward Lin Dashan's face. No dialogue. The cardiac monitor emits its continuous "beep——" tone, accompanied by faint fabric rustling as Zhou Fen trembles.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a near shot with a fixed locked-off camera, still within <Subject 3>'s ward. <Subject 2> Zhou Fen knee-walks forward, crawling closer to <Subject 1> Lin Dashan's bedside, her hands gripping the bed rail, her curly hair now disheveled, her heavily made-up face contorted as she wails and clamors. In her shrill, shrewish middle-aged female voice, urgent and breaking with sobs, she cries, <d>[Chinese] 老林！你终于醒了，林初这丫头把我欺负得走投无路，你得给我做主啊！</d> Her cries echo slightly in the ward; the sharp clicks of high heels strike the floor as she shifts forward on her knees, over the continuing monitor beep.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 1> Lin Dashan's face, fixed locked-off camera. His eyes are icy behind the thin metal-rimmed glasses, the corner of his mouth sneers slightly, and his facial muscles are taut with fury, every wrinkle and pore rendered in photoreal detail under the warm lamp light. In a frail but forceful, hoarse elderly male voice, he roars low, <d>[Chinese] 闭嘴！我在昏迷里……全听得一清二楚！你这个狠毒的毒妇！</d> The instant his roar ends, the ward drops into sudden dead silence — the high-heel clicks and sobs cease — and only the cardiac monitor's "beep——" continues steadily to the final frame.
